title: Go SDK: typed envelope versioning and graceful decoding for streaming responses
creator: Maya Sinclair
description: Parcel a robust approach to decoding typed structs from streamed Redwood responses when model/response envelope versions drift. Deliver generic helpers that: (1) detect envelope version from the first chunk, (2) pick the correct typed decoder (with generics where possible), and (3) fall back to a best-effort unstructured decode preserving unknown fields. Ensure behavior is deterministic across retry and reconnect scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: New Go helpers exist to register multiple envelope versions and provide a stable DecodeStream[T any](stream io.Reader) (returns typed T and preserved unknown JSON bytes)
Streaming client can switch decoder mid-stream if initial chunk indicates an older envelope version and subsequent chunks change version (rare) without panicking
On unknown fields, decoder attaches them to a RawExtras map on the typed struct rather than failing
Unit tests cover single-chunk, multi-chunk, interleaved-version, and retry-reconnect flows
Benchmarks show <8% overhead compared to current untyped streaming path for typical chat workloads
design_notes: We add an EnvelopeRegistry that maps version strings to a DecoderFactory function. Registry is package-level but thread-safe.
Prefer generics-based API: DecodeStream[T any](ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, opts ...DecodeOption) (T, DecodeMeta, error)
DecodeMeta must be a flat string map in Linear JSON (we will serialize fields into 'meta.version' and 'meta.rawExtras') for ticket metadata; actual Go type will be a struct.

On encountering unknown envelope version, attempt to apply the closest compatible decoder based on a compatibility table; if none exists, switch to permissive decode that returns map[string]json.RawMessage under RawExtras
To preserve performance we only do reflective decoding for the first chunk to discover version; subsequent tokenization uses precompiled decoders when available
For streaming retries: decoder must be idempotent with respect to reprocessing partial chunks. Implement checkpointing by byte-offset and token index in the DecodeMeta
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Add EnvelopeRegistry, DecoderFactory interface, and basic version detection logic (2 pts)
Phase 2: Implement generics DecodeStream[T any] with fallback to RawExtras and tests for simple chat generation (3 pts)
Phase 3: Handle mid-stream version switches and implement compatibility table + unit tests (2 pts)
Phase 4: Benchmarks and perf tuning, integrate with existing streaming retry middleware (1 pt)
Create PRs: sdk-go#2612 (registry+decoder), sdk-go#2619 (streaming generic helpers), sdk-go#2627 (perf/tests)
milestones: 2026-02-26: Integration tests with streaming retry middleware
blockers: Need decision on surface area: whether to add RawExtras field on all generated response structs or return it via DecodeMeta (PM prefers no struct churn)
Awaiting runtime team input on how model variants expose envelope version header (HTTP header vs first JSON chunk)
notes_and_discussions: 2026-02-11: PM review (J. Ortega) - requested that unknown-fields be surfaced to customers as part of an opt-in debug flag
2026-02-14: Design sync - agreed to keep default behavior permissive and gate extra payloads behind DecodeOption(WithExtras)
2026-02-18: Engineering spike showed reflective fallback adds ~12% CPU at small packet sizes; planned mitigations: reuse decoder pools and avoid reflection except at first-chunk detection
2026-02-24: UX/Docs note - provide examples for both typed apps (strict decode) and observability tooling (extras enabled)
2026-02-27: Security review input - ensure RawExtras bytes are passed through KMS scrubber if containing potential PII when upload-to-logs is enabled
example_snippets:
// Retry-aware usage: resume from last checkpoint
ckpt := meta.Checkpoint
reader := resumeReaderFromStream(server, ckpt)
out, meta, err = go_sdk.DecodeStream[MyResponse](ctx, reader)
testing_notes: Add fuzz tests that mutate envelope.version field in early chunks
Simulate network reconnects where first N bytes repeat; ensure DecodeStream returns deterministic errors rather than panics
Integrate tests into CI that run both small and large tokenized payloads to capture perf regressions
final_decision_log: 2026-02-25: Final: use DecodeMeta return value to surface raw extras instead of changing every generated struct (decision by consensus)
2026-02-26: Final: envelope version will be declared in the first JSON chunk under 'envelope_version' field; runtime team will add a header in the next runtime release as optional optimization
